item.title: Designing a Coding Agent Without a KV Cache
item.description: 中文版是这篇文章的默认版本。 阅读中文版 → This English page stays available at this URL; the Chinese version is the one we maintain first. A design note from September 2026 gathers six coding-agent complaints under one sentence. Suppose a language model had no KV cache. What would these agents look like then. The answer contains no stronger model. It contains one thing, someone deciding what goes in front of the model on every turn.
